newsitem.title: GERMANY: SOCCER-BOBIC HAT-TRICK HELPS STUTTGART TO 5-1 WIN.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-BOBIC HAT-TRICK HELPS STUTTGART TO 5-1 WIN.

text.p: A Fredi Bobic hat-trick revived VfB Stuttgart's flagging Bundesliga title challenge on Tuesday.
Hig goals helped Stuttgart to a stunning 5-1 away win over Cologne and saw them jump ahead of Bayer Leverkusen into third place in the table.
They trail both defending champions Borussia Dortmund and Bayern Munich by just two points but have played one game more than the leading pair who play on Wednesday.
There was no hint of the onslaught to come when Rico Steinmann put Cologne ahead in the 20th minute.
Germany international Bobic equalised within a minute and put Stuttgart ahead with a second after 33 minutes.

The second half belonged to the visitors, with Brazilian Elber scoring his side's third in the 55th minute and Bobic and substitute Krisztian Lisztes putting the icing on the cake with further strikes in the final four minutes.
Bobic's three goals made him the first division's top marksman with 16 goals. He overhauled Karlsruhe's Sean Dundee who has hit 14.
Stuttgart's victory was their first in Cologne since 1991.
